photos.sample: WhatFontIs-Bench development photos of Google families, every fifteenth

variants.photo: the crop as the page reads it: its lines, cleaned unless two-tone (src/clean.mjs); every variant below is read the same way
variants.clean: the word at 64 px in the pinned instance of the photo's face, black on white
variants.binarized: Otsu's threshold on luminance as ink
variants.flattened: the background under the letters taken away first (an opening of the ink), then Otsu
variants.colour: ink as the position between the background's and the ink's colours (two means in RGB), then Otsu
variants.cleaned: the colour axis, flattened, Otsu and a 3×3 majority despeckle
variants.colour soft: the colour axis, the ink within 0.15 of Otsu's threshold keeping its grey
variants.colour flattened soft: the colour axis flattened, with the same soft edge
